system: MechMaker Periodic Table of Mining Minerals

materials.name: Hydrogen / Tritium
materials.industrial_role: Tokamak Plasma Injection & Cryogenic Vernier Propellant
materials.lore_description: The lifeblood of tactical thermonuclear propulsion and Cherenkov ignition.

materials.name: Helium-3
materials.industrial_role: Aneutronic Fusion Fuel for Minovsky-class magnetic containment
materials.lore_description: Harvested from billions of years of solar wind trapped in lunar titanium soils.

materials.name: Lithium-6
materials.industrial_role: Tritium Breeding Blankets & High-Rate Capacitor Plates
materials.lore_description: Ultra-light alkali metal critical for breeding weapon-grade tritium in orbital reactors.

materials.name: Beryllium
materials.industrial_role: Neutron Reflector Mirrors & Lightweight Aerospace Avionics Rigs
materials.lore_description: Rigid, non-magnetic, and extremely toxic in dust form; indispensable for aerospace cockpits.

materials.name: Boron (Boron-Nitride)
materials.industrial_role: High-Heat Ablative Ceramic Tile Matrices & Neutron Absorption Rods
materials.lore_description: Forms cubic boron nitride, the second hardest known structural armor material.

materials.name: Carbon (Graphene/Diamondoid)
materials.industrial_role: Carbon-Nanotube Actuator Weave, Reactive Armor Mesh & Heat Radiators
materials.lore_description: The structural backbone of modern mobile suit muscle bundles and anti-ballistic armor.

materials.name: Nitrogen (Cryo-Liquid)
materials.industrial_role: Superconductor Cryo-Coolant Loops & Thruster Gas Expansion
materials.lore_description: Pressurized liquid coolant pumped directly over glowing tokamak core coils.

materials.name: Oxygen (Liquid O2)
materials.industrial_role: Pilot Life Support & Chemical Afterburner Hypergolic Oxidizer
materials.lore_description: Electrolyzed directly from lunar oxide minerals to keep mercenary pilots breathing.

materials.name: Fluorine
materials.industrial_role: Dielectric Insulating Gas & Uranium Hexafluoride Centrifuge Enrichment
materials.lore_description: Violently reactive halogen essential for processing rare actinide fuels.

materials.name: Neon
materials.industrial_role: Cryogenic Laser Pulse Cavities & Plasma Discharge Sights
materials.lore_description: Emits brilliant orange-red discharge used in targeting alignment lasers.

materials.name: Sodium
materials.industrial_role: Liquid Metal Reactor Coolant Loops for High-Flux Cores
materials.lore_description: Carries immense thermal loads from compact cores to secondary turbines without boiling.

materials.name: Magnesium
materials.industrial_role: Ultra-Lightweight Casting Alloys for Leg Vernier Bells
materials.lore_description: Reduces total chassis dry weight to increase high-G orbital dash velocity.

materials.name: Aluminum (Alumino-Alloy)
materials.industrial_role: Structural Bulkhead Subframes & Cockpit Escape Pod Shells
materials.lore_description: Cheap, malleable, and universally available across every planetary outpost.

materials.name: Silicon (Silicon-Carbide)
materials.industrial_role: Sub-Nanometer Avionics Chips & High-Voltage Power Inverter Gates
materials.lore_description: The foundation of all targeting sensors, HUD overlays, and cybernetic links.

materials.name: Phosphorus
materials.industrial_role: Semiconductor Dopant & Incendiary Flechette Warhead Cores
materials.lore_description: Infused into silicon to create high-speed P-N junctions for fire-control radar.

materials.name: Sulfur
materials.industrial_role: Extreme-Pressure Lubricants & Solid-State Lithium-Sulfur Batteries
materials.lore_description: Mined by robotic skimmers diving into Io sulfur geysers; lubricates heavy knee joints.

materials.name: Chlorine
materials.industrial_role: High-Purity Chemical Vapor Deposition & Metal Etching Agent
materials.lore_description: Essential for cleaning vacuum-deposited titanium armors during manufacturing.

materials.name: Argon
materials.industrial_role: Inert Gas Shielding for Electron-Beam Welding & Ion Propulsion
materials.lore_description: Inert buffer gas used when welding reactive titanium-tungsten chassis in zero-g.

materials.name: Potassium
materials.industrial_role: NaK Eutectic Liquid Metal Reactor Coolant
materials.lore_description: Remains liquid down to -12°C, preventing cooling lines from freezing in deep vacuum.

materials.name: Calcium
materials.industrial_role: Metallurgical Reducing Agent for Uranium and Rare Earth Oxides
materials.lore_description: Used in high-temperature flux crucibles to strip oxygen from raw actinide ores.

materials.name: Scandium
materials.industrial_role: Scandium-Aluminum Welded Ribs for Atmospheric Jet Intakes
materials.lore_description: Prevents recrystallization cracking in high-stress mobile suit wing surfaces.

materials.name: Titanium (Titan-Matrix)
materials.industrial_role: Primary Lightweight High-Strength Armor Plating & Hydraulic Shafts
materials.lore_description: The gold standard for mobile suit limbs, balancing impact resilience and low inertia.

materials.name: Vanadium
materials.industrial_role: Chrome-Vanadium High-Torque Gearsets & Shock-Absorber Springs
materials.lore_description: Prevents heavy hydraulic foot-pads from shattering upon high-altitude orbital drop.

materials.name: Chromium
materials.industrial_role: Corrosion-Proof Mirror Plating & Laser Reflector Shrouds
materials.lore_description: Gives chassis components their high-specular chrome sheen and beam-deflection polish.

materials.name: Manganese
materials.industrial_role: Deoxidizer for Heavy Tank-Tread Steel & Recoil Brake Liners
materials.lore_description: Increases steel hardness and abrasion resistance against sandstorms and regolith.

materials.name: Iron (Ferrum / Armored Steel)
materials.industrial_role: Heavy Low-Cost Structural Steel Frames & Kinetic Slug Ammunition
materials.lore_description: The workhorse element of all war economies; Psyche 16 contains billions of tons.

materials.name: Cobalt (Cobalt-Azure)
materials.industrial_role: High-Temperature Turbine Blades, Superalloys & Samarium-Cobalt Magnets
materials.lore_description: Retains tensile strength at temperatures that turn ordinary steels into glowing taffy.

materials.name: Nickel (Inconel-Grade)
materials.industrial_role: Inconel Heat Shields & Monel Anti-Acid Thruster Injectors
materials.lore_description: Impervious to corrosive propellant vapors and scorching atmospheric re-entry heat.

materials.name: Copper
materials.industrial_role: High-Current Reactor Busbars & Railgun Linear Acceleration Rails
materials.lore_description: Carries thousands of mega-amperes into railgun barrel stators during firing.

materials.name: Zinc
materials.industrial_role: Galvanic Sacrificial Anodes & Precision Die-Cast Bushings
materials.lore_description: Prevents galvanic corrosion between dissimilar metals in damp planetary combat zones.

materials.name: Gallium (Gallium-Arsenide)
materials.industrial_role: Ultra-High Frequency Radar Arrays & Liquid Metal Thermal Paste
materials.lore_description: Melts in human hands; provides thermal interface between reactor cores and heat sinks.

materials.name: Germanium
materials.industrial_role: Infrared Night-Vision Lenses & High-Speed Optical Modulators
materials.lore_description: Transparent to long-wave thermal IR; lets snipers spot enemy mechs through smoke.

materials.name: Arsenic
materials.industrial_role: Semiconductor Dopant for Gallium-Arsenide Laser Diodes
materials.lore_description: Highly toxic metalloid essential for military laser guidance and lidar targeting.

materials.name: Selenium
materials.industrial_role: Photoreceptor Drums & Rectifiers for Laser Weapon Power Conditioners
materials.lore_description: Converts optical photons directly into electronic triggers with zero latency.

materials.name: Bromine
materials.industrial_role: Fire-Retardant Cockpit Foam & Heavy Halon Suppression Systems
materials.lore_description: Extinguishes electrical and plasma fires in cockpits before pilots are consumed.

materials.name: Krypton
materials.industrial_role: High-Intensity Airfield Runway Flashers & Excimer Beam Resonators
materials.lore_description: Produces ultraviolet excimer laser pulses capable of blinding optical sensor domes.

materials.name: Rubidium
materials.industrial_role: Rubidium Atomic Clocks for Tactical Fleet Frequency Synchronization
materials.lore_description: Ensures sub-nanosecond clock sync so ECM frequency hopping cannot be jammed.

materials.name: Strontium
materials.industrial_role: Ferrite Magnets & Optical Lattice Atomic Frequency Standards
materials.lore_description: Used in radar emitter beam-steering magnets to sweep targets without moving parts.

materials.name: Yttrium (YBCO Super-Flux)
materials.industrial_role: High-Temperature Superconducting YBCO Coils & Laser YAG Crystals
materials.lore_description: Enables zero-resistance power distribution to plasma cannons without meltdown.

materials.name: Zirconium
materials.industrial_role: Nuclear Fuel Cladding & High-Impact Ceramic Knife Blades
materials.lore_description: Almost transparent to thermal neutrons; ideal cladding for compact reactor fuel rods.

materials.name: Niobium
materials.industrial_role: Niobium-Titanium Superconducting Wire & Rocket Nozzle Bells
materials.lore_description: Withstands glowing rocket exhaust plume erosion in liquid-fuel thruster throats.

materials.name: Molybdenum
materials.industrial_role: Ultra-High Temperature Armored Grids & Tank Armor Alloying
materials.lore_description: Prevents steel temper embrittlement; essential for armor intended to take repetitive kinetic hits.

materials.name: Technetium
materials.industrial_role: Beta-Emitting Corrosion-Resistant Plating & Radiation Tracers
materials.lore_description: Artificially synthesized radioactive metal with extreme resistance to chemical oxidation.

materials.name: Ruthenium
materials.industrial_role: Electrical Switch Contacts & Hard Disk Nanomagnetic Underlayers
materials.lore_description: Immense wear resistance; handles millions of high-voltage contact closures without pitting.

materials.name: Rhodium
materials.industrial_role: Searchlight Reflectors & Catalyst for Hydrocarbon Synthesis
materials.lore_description: Reflects up to 80% of incident laser energy, acting as mirror coating on cockpits.

materials.name: Palladium
materials.industrial_role: Cold Hydrogen Sponge Storage & Micro-Electronics Capacitors
materials.lore_description: Can absorb 900 times its own volume of hydrogen gas, acting as a compact solid fuel tank.

materials.name: Silver
materials.industrial_role: Highest Electrical Conductivity Wire & Antimicrobial Water Systems
materials.lore_description: Used in high-speed micro-vias where nano-second signal delay cannot be tolerated.

materials.name: Cadmium
materials.industrial_role: Reactor Emergency Control Rods & Nickel-Cadmium Buffer Cells
materials.lore_description: Captures runaway thermal neutrons instantly to prevent Chernobyl-class meltdowns.

materials.name: Indium
materials.industrial_role: Indium-Tin-Oxide (ITO) Heads-Up Display Screens & Cryogenic Gaskets
materials.lore_description: Forms transparent conductive films on cockpit canopies to project tactical flight HUDs.

materials.name: Tin
materials.industrial_role: Lead-Free Micro-Soldering & Niobium-Tin (Nb3Sn) Superconductors
materials.lore_description: Essential for wave soldering thousands of logic boards across every mobile suit sub-rack.

materials.name: Antimony
materials.industrial_role: Lead-Acid Hardener & Infrared Focal Plane Array Detectors
materials.lore_description: Expands slightly upon cooling, enabling razor-sharp replication in precision casting molds.

materials.name: Tellurium
materials.industrial_role: Cadmium-Telluride Solar Collector Arrays & Machinability Additive
materials.lore_description: Improves steel cutting speeds so manufacturing bays can churn out more chassis per shift.

materials.name: Iodine
materials.industrial_role: Iodine Plasma Ion Thrusters & Van Arkel Metal Purification
materials.lore_description: High atomic mass enables high thrust efficiency in satellite station-keeping verniers.

materials.name: Xenon
materials.industrial_role: Heavy Ion Propellant for Long-Range Planetary Transit Craft
materials.lore_description: Dense noble gas providing tremendous specific impulse in electrostatic ion thrusters.

materials.name: Cesium
materials.industrial_role: Primary SI Unit Cesium Atomic Clocks & Magnetohydrodynamic Generators
materials.lore_description: Ionizes under mere optical light; used in direct thermal-to-electric plasma turbines.

materials.name: Barium
materials.industrial_role: High-Temperature YBCO Superconductor Matrices & Spark Plugs
materials.lore_description: Anchors oxygen atoms inside copper-oxide crystal planes in zero-loss superconductor tapes.

materials.name: Lanthanum
materials.industrial_role: Lanthanum-Hexaboride (LaB6) Cathodes for Electron-Beam Guns
materials.lore_description: Emits floods of electrons with minimal heat; powers precision welding electron guns.

materials.name: Cerium
materials.industrial_role: Mischmetal Spark Igniters & Optical Lens Polishing Slurries
materials.lore_description: Polishes telescopic sniper optics to sub-angstrom optical smoothness.

materials.name: Praseodymium
materials.industrial_role: Didymium Pilot Visor Glass & Ultra-High Magnetic Field Coils
materials.lore_description: Filters out blinding sodium flares from rocket engines so pilots retain combat vision.

materials.name: Neodymium
materials.industrial_role: NdFeB Permanent Servo Magnets for Robotic Joint Motors
materials.lore_description: Produces immense magnetic torque inside mobile suit elbow and shoulder rotary servos.

materials.name: Promethium
materials.industrial_role: Atomic Radioisotope Thermoelectric Batteries for Deep Space Beacons
materials.lore_description: Glows with eerie green-violet radioluminescence; powers recon probes for 20 years.

materials.name: Samarium
materials.industrial_role: SmCo Magnets for Cryogenic and High-Heat Joint Actuators
materials.lore_description: Maintains magnetic coherence up to 350°C, where neodymium magnets completely demagnetize.

materials.name: Europium
materials.industrial_role: Neutron Poison Control Blades & Red Phosphor Tactical Displays
materials.lore_description: Strongest neutron absorption cross-section of all common rare earth elements.

materials.name: Gadolinium
materials.industrial_role: Magnetic Refrigeration Alloys & Extreme MRI Diagnostic Telemetry
materials.lore_description: Undergoes giant magnetocaloric effect, cooling reactor coils without moving fluids.

materials.name: Terbium
materials.industrial_role: Terfenol-D Magnetostrictive Sonar Actuators & Sonic Hull Disruptors
materials.lore_description: Changes physical length in magnetic fields to generate high-power acoustic shockwaves.

materials.name: Dysprosium
materials.industrial_role: Thermal Stabilizer for High-Speed Motor Magnets & Nuclear Rods
materials.lore_description: Added to neodymium magnets to stop high-speed maneuvering servos from burning out.

materials.name: Holmium
materials.industrial_role: Highest Magnetic Flux Concentrator Pole Pieces & Holmium Lasers
materials.lore_description: Focuses magnetic lines of force into dense bundles to constrain runaway fusion arcs.

materials.name: Erbium
materials.industrial_role: Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifiers (EDFA) for Secure Laser Comms
materials.lore_description: Boosts laser communications through planetary dust storms without electronic decryption.

materials.name: Thulium
materials.industrial_role: Portable Portable X-Ray Inspection Sources for Weld Flaws
materials.lore_description: Lets armorers inspect internal chassis weld cracks right on the combat flight deck.

materials.name: Ytterbium
materials.industrial_role: High-Power Fiber Laser Weapon Resonators & Stress Gauges
materials.lore_description: Powers 50-kilowatt point-defense fiber lasers used to disintegrate incoming swarm missiles.

materials.name: Lutetium
materials.industrial_role: Cerium-Doped Lutetium Silicate (LSO) Scintillators for Gamma Detectors
materials.lore_description: Detects enemy thermonuclear reactor ignition signatures across planetary orbital bands.

materials.name: Hafnium
materials.industrial_role: Extreme-Temperature Rocket Plasma Nozzles & Nuclear Control Rods
materials.lore_description: Forms hafnium carbide, withstanding scorching 3,900°C plasma torch blasts without erosion.

materials.name: Tantalum
materials.industrial_role: Tantalum Micro-Capacitors & Acid-Resistant Chemical Liners
materials.lore_description: Immune to almost all chemical acids; houses unstable rocket propellants in combat droptanks.

materials.name: Tungsten (Wolfram / Vanguard-Grade)
materials.industrial_role: APFSDS Kinetic Penetrator Darts, Heavy Armor Plate & Railgun Slugs
materials.lore_description: Dense, unyielding, and heavy; the ultimate kinetic penetrator core against thick armor.

materials.name: Rhenium
materials.industrial_role: Single-Crystal Turbine Blades for Overclocked Afterburners
materials.lore_description: Prevents creep deformation in single-crystal turbine blades operating above their melting point.

materials.name: Osmium (Ultra-Dense Osmiridium)
materials.industrial_role: The Densest Known Structural Armor Slab & Pivot Pin Bearings
materials.lore_description: Twice as dense as lead; shrugs off direct kinetic hypervelocity impact spikes.

materials.name: Iridium
materials.industrial_role: High-Temperature Crucible Liners & Plasma Discharge Electrodes
materials.lore_description: Most corrosion-resistant metal known; survives inside raging 3,000°C molten alloy crucibles.

materials.name: Platinum
materials.industrial_role: Catalytic Recombiners & Oxygen Sensors for Closed-Loop Cockpits
materials.lore_description: Catalyzes volatile hydrogen gas leakage before explosive concentrations accumulate in hangars.

materials.name: Gold
materials.industrial_role: Infrared Radiant Heat Foil Blankets & Gold-Coated Visor Glass
materials.lore_description: Reflects 99% of infrared thermal flash from nuclear detonations away from pilot cockpits.

materials.name: Mercury
materials.industrial_role: Liquid Metal Slip Rings for Rotating Turret Mounts & Ion Thrust
materials.lore_description: Maintains continuous electrical contact across rotating gun turret rings with zero friction.

materials.name: Thallium
materials.industrial_role: Low-Melting Optical Glasses & High-Critical-Temperature Superconductors
materials.lore_description: Thallium-barium-calcium-copper oxide superconductors operate at up to 138 Kelvin.

materials.name: Lead
materials.industrial_role: Radiation Shielding Blankets & Ballast Weight Counterbalances
materials.lore_description: Lined around pilot cockpits to stop lethal cosmic rays and gamma bursts from enemy beams.

materials.name: Bismuth
materials.industrial_role: Low-Melting Safety Release Plugs & Non-Toxic Shotgun Pellets
materials.lore_description: Expands on solidifying; melts rapidly at 271°C to vent overpressurized reactor coolant tanks.

materials.name: Polonium
materials.industrial_role: High-Heat Alpha Emitter Heat Sources for Stealth Thermal Lures
materials.lore_description: Decays with intense alpha energy, creating incandescent decoy flares that misguide IR missiles.

materials.name: Astatine
materials.industrial_role: Targeted Alpha Radiation Emitter for Electronic Disruption Dust
materials.lore_description: Short-lived halogen used in electronic-warfare aerosol grenades to blind thermal cameras.

materials.name: Radon
materials.industrial_role: Radiological Minefield Dispersion Gas for Area Denial Zones
materials.lore_description: Heavy radioactive gas pooling in craters and trench lines to poison invading infantry sappers.

materials.name: Francium
materials.industrial_role: Exotic High-Activity Atomic Sensor Physics Calibration
materials.lore_description: The most unstable natural metal; decays in minutes, used in exotic quantum sensor labs.

materials.name: Radium
materials.industrial_role: Self-Luminous Tritium-Free Emergency Dials & Radiometric Calibrators
materials.lore_description: Glows in the pitch dark of damaged cockpits even after complete electrical bus blackout.

materials.name: Actinium
materials.industrial_role: Alpha Radiation Emitter for Exotic Directed Energy Warheads
materials.lore_description: Intensely radioactive actinide used in dirty kinetic cluster munitions.

materials.name: Thorium (Thorium-232)
materials.industrial_role: Proliferation-Resistant Molten Salt Breeder Reactors & TIG Welding
materials.lore_description: Abundant fuel for civilian and mercenary power plants; impossible to melt down catastrophically.

materials.name: Protactinium
materials.industrial_role: Nuclear Fuel Intermediary & High-Flux Physics Targets
materials.lore_description: Intermediate actinide formed during thorium breeder reactor cycles.

materials.name: Uranium (Depleted U-238 / Enriched U-235)
materials.industrial_role: Depleted Uranium Kinetic Tank Dart Sabots & Fission Cores
materials.lore_description: Self-sharpening pyrophoric kinetic sabot; ignites into white-hot sparks upon armor penetration.

materials.name: Neptunium
materials.industrial_role: Precursor for Plutonium-238 Deep Space Power Batteries
materials.lore_description: Heavy transuranic metal isolated from spent fuel rods to fuel scout probes.

materials.name: Plutonium (Pu-239)
materials.industrial_role: Thermonuclear Trigger Pits & Compact Radioisotope Generators
materials.lore_description: Warm to the touch from continuous alpha decay; the trigger for civilization-ending warheads.

materials.name: Americium
materials.industrial_role: Neutron Moisture Gauges & Ionization Cockpit Smoke Detectors
materials.lore_description: Detects toxic smoke and smoldering wire insulation in cockpits within fractions of a second.

materials.name: Curium
materials.industrial_role: Alpha-Particle X-Ray Spectrometer Sources for Planetary Rovers
materials.lore_description: Mounted on rover robotic arms to identify rich alloy ore veins in uncharted asteroid belts.

materials.name: Berkelium
materials.industrial_role: Target Element for Synthesizing Super-Heavy Transactinide Armors
materials.lore_description: Costs millions per microgram; synthesized in planetary cyclotrons to create artificial elements.

materials.name: Californium (Cf-252)
materials.industrial_role: Spontaneous Neutron Emitter for Scanning Welds & Starting Reactors
materials.lore_description: Pumps millions of neutrons per second; initiates startup chain reactions in dormant mecha cores.

materials.name: Einsteinium
materials.industrial_role: High-Radiation Experimental Physics Research
materials.lore_description: First discovered in the fallout of multi-megaton hydrogen bomb tests.

materials.name: Fermium
materials.industrial_role: The Heaviest Element Produced via Neutron Bombardment
materials.lore_description: The final boundary of neutron-capture synthesis before nuclear fission tears the nucleus apart.

materials.name: Mendelevium
materials.industrial_role: Heavy Actinide Chemistry Calibration
materials.lore_description: Produced one atom at a time; used to verify exotic heavy actinide sub-shell properties.

materials.name: Nobelium
materials.industrial_role: Relativistic D-Shell Shielding Research
materials.lore_description: Exhibits strange relativistic electron contraction effects in high-gravity environments.

materials.name: Lawrencium
materials.industrial_role: Final Element of the Actinide Series
materials.lore_description: Behaves like a heavy transition metal, bridging actinides to super-heavy transuranic armors.

materials.name: Rutherfordium
materials.industrial_role: Super-Heavy Transactinide Armor Matrix Precursor
materials.lore_description: First transactinide element; exhibits abnormal crystal density in orbital particle crucibles.

materials.name: Dubnium
materials.industrial_role: Heavy High-Density Ballistic Core Infusion
materials.lore_description: Synthesized in high-energy cyclotrons; stabilizes dense super-alloys under high pressure.

materials.name: Seaborgium
materials.industrial_role: Hexacarbonyl Transuranic Gas Enrichment
materials.lore_description: Forms volatile carbonyl gases used to deposit ultra-dense atomic armor coatings.

materials.name: Bohrium
materials.industrial_role: High-Z Atomic Shielding for Antimatter Injection Tubes
materials.lore_description: Absorbs secondary bremsstrahlung radiation inside antimatter-catalyzed propulsion engines.

materials.name: Hassium
materials.industrial_role: The Heaviest Group 8 Transition Metal Known
materials.lore_description: Theoretical density exceeds 40 g/cm³, offering unprecedented stopping power against railguns.

materials.name: Meitnerium
materials.industrial_role: Exotic High-Field Superconducting Grid Sputtering
materials.lore_description: Named after Lise Meitner; provides anomalous field expulsion in pulsed magnetic shields.

materials.name: Darmstadtium
materials.industrial_role: Platinum-Group Transuranic Catalytic Matrix
materials.lore_description: Catalyzes dense exotic hydrogen isotope fusion at room temperature for fleeting milliseconds.

materials.name: Roentgenium
materials.industrial_role: Super-Heavy Golden-Bronze Plating for Sensor Cloaking
materials.lore_description: Relativistic gold congener reflecting exotic radar and tachyon sensor wavelengths.

materials.name: Copernicium
materials.industrial_role: Volatile Liquid Transuranic Solder for Cyber-Neural Cores
materials.lore_description: Behaves like an ultra-dense noble liquid metal; interfaces synthetic neurons with quantum processors.

materials.name: Nihonium
materials.industrial_role: Super-Heavy P-Block Semiconductor Dopant
materials.lore_description: Creates exotic bandgap semiconductors for zero-latency neural reflex bridges.

materials.name: Flerovium (Island of Stability Metal)
materials.industrial_role: Island of Stability Super-Armor & Graviton Deflection Matrix
materials.lore_description: Lies on the theoretical Island of Stability; long-lived transuranic metal with bizarre inertial dampening.

materials.name: Moscovium
materials.industrial_role: High-Z Antigravity Propulsion Waveguide Alloy
materials.lore_description: Famous in military lore; generates micro-gravitational field distortions when bombarded with protons.

materials.name: Livermorium
materials.industrial_role: Chalcogen Transuranic Radiation Absorber Blanket
materials.lore_description: Absorbs extreme neutron flux from exploding matter-antimatter warheads.

materials.name: Tennessine
materials.industrial_role: Super-Heavy Halogen Flux for Quantum Crucible Smelting
materials.lore_description: Lowers the melting threshold of exotic actinide alloys during planetary field forging.

materials.name: Oganesson (Void-Gas / Monolithium Base)
materials.industrial_role: Super-Heavy Polarizable Noble Solid & Void-Shield Emitter Core
materials.lore_description: The apex of the periodic table; a relativistic noble semiconductor powering experimental void barrier shielding.
